name: Hume Cement Industries Berhad
summary: Hume Cement Industries Berhad, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells cement, concrete, and related products in Malaysia. It sells its cement products under the Panda Cement brand. The company was formerly known as Hume Industries Berhad and changed its name to Hume Cement Industries Berhad in November 2020. Hume Cement Industries Berhad was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia. Hume Cement Industries Berhad is a subsidiary of Hong Leong Manufacturing Group Sdn Bhd.
